system: You are a helpful assistant. Follow the user's instructions precisely. Remember earlier decisions and use the latest value when a decision changes.

turns.padding: The workshop needs seating, lighting, signage, and a clear check-in process.

Recall our project codename and current budget. Reply only with JSON using keys codename and budget.

turns.padding: Volunteers will prepare signs, arrange chairs, check the lighting, and welcome attendees.
turns.user: Do not change the workshop facts. Name two practical preparation tasks in one short sentence.

turns.padding: The team will review the schedule, test the check-in desk, and label every room.
turns.user: What dietary rule did we agree on at the beginning? Reply with only that one word.

turns.padding: The event plan includes registration, introductions, discussion, a break, and closing remarks.
turns.user: Using our latest decisions, reply only with JSON using keys codename, venue, budget, and diet. Include all four values and no explanation.
